If you’re not from Iceland, you might not understand just how valuable this information is. Title: BatTool

The user can project the abundance of a bat population of several species using its estimated rate of population growth, including stochasticity and the effects of stressors in the form of direct mortality and reductions to vital rates.

Organization: University of Maryland Center for Environmental Science
Title: What will climate feel like in 60 years?
Description: This web application helps to provide answers to these questions. We don’t have time machines so we can’t travel to the year 2080. However, we can think about places that are warmer and wetter (or drier) today than we where live. Perhaps you have even traveled to such a place for a holiday or for work and experienced that place’s weather. We can ask: If climate continues to change, how much will my home town feel like some warmer and wetter (or drier) place?

Title: POTUS Economic Scorecard

Title: EF3.1 Ecotox Explorer

Title: SIML@B: an EC tool for sensitivity analysis
